### Requirements

- requirements[0]: Prefer a committed lockfile, isolated virtual environment, and reproducible locked install.
- requirements[1]: Prefer wheels; treat source distributions, editable installs, and PEP 517 or 518 backends as arbitrary code execution.
- requirements[2]: Keep build isolation enabled unless an exception is reviewed.
- requirements[3]: Review additional indexes and prevent public or private index dependency confusion.
- requirements[4]: Do not install into host or system Python.
- requirements[5]: Apply the 7-day package quarantine before resolving new versions.

### Verification

- verification[0]: dependency_vulnerability_scan
- verification[1]: configured_static_analysis_and_type_checking
- verification[2]: tests_and_applicable_property_or_fuzz_tests
